اقترئوا (form VIII)
# اُقْتُرِئُوا (uqturiʔū) /uq.tu.ri.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
# اِقْتَرِئُوا (iqtariʔū) /iq.ta.ri.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَرَأَ (iqtaraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
